description: Light twin displayed at Mang'u High School. Painted as 5Y-MHS which a Spottingmode contributor assessed in May 2026 as probably false because the same registration has also been applied to the school's Boeing 737. tail_number is left blank because no true identity has been established.

Former Kenya Airways 737-700 donated to Mang'u High School. In December 2024 it was still at Nairobi airport painted in a school scheme awaiting transport; a May 2026 Spottingmode entry places it at the school and describes it as carrying the 5Y-MHS marking. Recorded as an instructional and display airframe on the school campus.
